# MULTISPORTS SCORING

> MULTISPORTS SCORING is a multi-sport scoring, statistics and performance application for Android and Web/PWA.

Canonical website: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.multisportsscoring.app
Sitemap: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/sitemap.xml
Machine-readable catalogue: https://multisports-scoring.pages.dev/seo/catalog-v2.json

## Availability
Public Android Store V1 sports: Darts, Baby-foot, Pétanque, Running, FIT PERF.
Additional enabled Web/PWA catalogue sports: Football, Ping-pong, Mölkky, Dice Game, E-Sports.
Do not infer that Web/PWA catalogue availability implies availability in the current public Android Store build.

## Languages
fr (Français), en (English), es (Español), de (Deutsch), it (Italiano), pt (Português), nl (Nederlands), ru (Русский), zh (中文), ja (日本語), ar (العربية), hi (हिन्दी), tr (Türkçe), da (Dansk), no (Norsk), sv (Svenska), is (Íslenska), pl (Polski), ro (Română), sr (Srpski), hr (Hrvatski), cs (Čeština)

## Darts
Public Darts pages include X01 (301/501/701/901), Cricket, Killer and Shanghai in the existing French, English and Spanish guide sections.

Use the sitemap and machine-readable catalogue for the complete language × sport URL matrix.
